Kit summary

Cold Sword AuraBasic
Deals 100% DEF DMG and 100% DEF [Bleed] DMG to a single enemy, with a 90% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Frozen ShieldActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies a [Shield] by 40% of Chardonel's Max HP for 2 turns.
Frigid Shelter Lv.2Frozen Shield also increases all allies' SPD by 40% for 2 turns.
Frigid VeinsPassive
The [Bleed] DMG inflicted by Chardonel is calculated based on his DEF. Increases Chardonel's DEF by 8% of his initial HP Cap.
Chilling ComboActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 5 stages of 50% DEF DMG and 50% DEF [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy, each stage has a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Frigid Shelter Lv.1Each stage of Chilling Combo has a 100% chance to inflict [Heavy Bleed II] on the target for 2 turns. If [Heavy Bleed II] is successfully inflicted in the duration of Chilling Combo, each remaining stage will have a 100% chance to extend the duration of [Heavy Bleed II] by 1 turn instead. The chance of extending [Heavy Bleed II] is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.
Frigid Shelter Lv.3The last stage of Chilling Combo also reduces the target's ATK by 40% and inflicts [Forgotten Wound] on the target for 2 turns. When an enemy with [Forgotten Wound] is under basic attack or takes skill damage from an ally, restores the ally's HP by 10% of Chardonel's Max HP. [Forgotten Wound] won't be removed if Chardonel dies. [Forgotten Wound] will only be inflicted on 1 enemy.
Source: game files.
